SELECT DISTINCT DM.SUBSCRIBER_ID + '00' AS MEMBERNUMBER FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_MEMBER DM   INNER JOIN [APP_CAEDM].[DW_FACT_USER_ASSIGNMENT] FUA ON FUA.MEME_CK = DM.MEME_CK 		INNER JOIN [APP_CAEDM].DW_DIM_DATE ENDDATE ON ENDDATE.DATE_KEY = FUA.END_DATE 		INNER JOIN [APP_CAEDM].DW_DIM_TIME ENDTIME ON ENDTIME.TIME_KEY = FUA.END_TIME 			AND GETDATE()<ENDDATE.DATE + ENDTIME.TIME 		INNER JOIN [APP_CAEDM].DW_DIM_DATE CREATEDATE ON CREATEDATE.DATE_KEY = FUA.CREATE_DATE 		INNER JOIN [APP_CAEDM].DW_DIM_TIME CREATETIME ON CREATETIME.TIME_KEY = FUA.CREATE_TIME 			AND GETDATE() >= CREATEDATE.DATE + CREATETIME.TIME 		INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_USER_ASSIGNMENT_STATUS DUAS ON FUA.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS = DUAS.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS 	WHERE DUAS.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_DESC <> 'Deleted'
